about.hero_subtitle: Learn about Mind Clear Space, view terms of service and privacy policy
about.p0: We believe everyone deserves to be heard and understood.
about.p1: In this fast-paced world, we hope to create a corner where you can pause and sit with your emotions for a while.
about.p2: Mind Clear Space is a public-service mental health education and emotional companionship platform. We offer emotion awareness, psychology education, relaxation exercises, and more to help you care for your inner self in daily life.
about.p3: Mind Clear Space is a public-service mental health education and emotional companionship platform. The emotional companionship, psychology education, and self-growth guidance we provide all fall within the scope of public mental health education and growth education.
about.p6: For the above situations, we will clearly guide you to seek professional treatment at a hospital's psychiatry department. We do not provide any alternative medical services.
about.p7: The emotion awareness scales provided by this platform (such as self-rating anxiety, self-rating depression, etc.) are simplified versions of standardized psychological assessment tools.
about.p8: When using this platform's services, you confirm that:
about.p9: To the maximum extent permitted by law, this platform is not liable for the following situations:
about.p10: Mind Clear Space provides the following services:
about.p13: All content on this platform (including but not limited to text, images, audio, video, software, etc.) is protected by intellectual property law. Unauthorized reproduction, distribution, or commercial use is prohibited.
about.p14: This platform reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate part or all of its services at any time without prior notice.
about.p15: This platform is primarily intended for adults. Minors should use this platform under the accompaniment and guidance of a guardian.
about.p16: We know that people who come here may be going through difficult times. Protecting your privacy is our most basic commitment.
about.p17: We may collect the following information:
about.p19: This platform uses cookies to improve user experience and analyze usage. You can manage cookies through your browser settings, but this may affect some features.
about.p20: We do not intentionally collect personal information from minors. If we find that we have collected minor's information without guardian consent, we will delete it as soon as possible.
about.p21: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Updated policies will be posted on this page. Please check back periodically.
about.p22: If you are going through a difficult time, please know that seeking help is a brave choice. Here are some hotlines that can provide professional assistance:
about.callout_text: Mind Clear Space is an emotional companionship platform, not a hospital or clinic. If you are experiencing severe psychological distress, please seek professional help. This is not shameful - it is a way of loving yourself.
about.h0: When should you seek professional help?
about.hotline_encourage: You don't have to carry it alone. Someone is willing to help.
about.important_notice: Important: Please read the following disclaimer carefully before using this platform
about.last_updated: This disclaimer was last updated in January 2024. If you have questions, please contact us through the platform's feedback channels.

charging_station.story_moral_s002: Courage is not the absence of fear, but moving forward with it.
charging_station.story_moral_s003: In the hardest moments, do not stop growing.
charging_station.story_moral_s004: Kindness spreads — even the warmth of a cup of coffee.
charging_station.story_moral_s006: Give yourself a pause button; the world will keep turning.
charging_station.story_moral_s007: Change your perspective and familiar views become poetry.
charging_station.story_moral_s008: Tending a plant with care is tending your own heart.
charging_station.story_moral_s009: Any work can be a form of practice.
charging_station.story_moral_s010: Curiosity is the explorer of the soul.
charging_station.story_moral_s011: Sometimes, simply being accompanied is healing.
charging_station.story_moral_s012: Love does not vanish; it only changes form.
charging_station.story_moral_s013: Accepting yourself is the gentlest reconciliation.
charging_station.story_moral_s014: Scars are not shame; they are medals.
charging_station.story_moral_s015: Everyone walking late at night deserves gentleness.
charging_station.story_moral_s016: Sleep in peace — someone is keeping watch for you.
charging_station.story_moral_s017: It is okay to go slow; what matters is keeping on.

charging_station.story_moral_s019: Find your own language and the world will hear you.

charging_station.story_moral_s021: Ordinary persistence is the deepest romance.
charging_station.story_moral_s022: Every book you read is quietly changing you.
charging_station.story_moral_s023: Passion is the best way to defy the passage of time.
charging_station.story_moral_s024: Farewell to the old life is the start of the new.
charging_station.story_moral_s025: Regret is not an end, but a signpost for growth.
charging_station.story_moral_s026: Being remembered is the most precious gift.
charging_station.story_moral_s027: Reconciling with your past self is the best gift to your future.
charging_station.story_moral_s028: Confiding is a strength, not a weakness.
charging_station.story_moral_s029: The one you most need to reconcile with is the you in the mirror.
charging_station.story_moral_s030: Falling asleep is the gentlest trust in yourself.

flow.page_title: Flow Experience Room - Discover Your Passion, Achieve Flow
flow.hero_subtitle: Choose an activity you love, invest 15-60 minutes, and experience the complete focus of flow state
flow.flow_intro_desc: When challenge and skill are perfectly matched, you naturally enter a state of complete absorption where time seems to stand still. This is "flow."
flow.flow_lesson_btn: Flow 101: New here? Click to learn what flow is
flow.flow_lesson_subtitle: Understand flow to make every moment of focus count
flow.flow_lesson_summary: Now, choose an activity that interests you, set a small goal, and experience true flow.
flow.lesson_point_1_desc: Knowing what to do and to what extent allows the brain to enter focus mode
flow.lesson_point_2_desc: Being able to clearly perceive your progress, with every step providing a response
flow.lesson_point_3_desc: Too easy leads to boredom, too hard leads to anxiety - "just right" is easiest for flow
flow.metaphor_just_right_desc: Just right, with a small challenge
flow.metaphor_stretch_desc: Requires effort, but I can do it
flow.metaphor_too_hard_desc: A bit tense, might need adjustment
flow.based_on_interest: Recommended based on your art interests
flow.prepare_env: Prepare your flow environment, minimize distractions
flow.check_notif: Turn off phone notifications or enable Do Not Disturb
flow.check_tools: Prepare the tools and materials you need
flow.breathing_exercise: Do a 1-minute breathing exercise to enter a focused state
flow.breath_guide: Inhale 4 seconds - Hold 4 seconds - Exhale 4 seconds
flow.goal_tip: We recommend choosing a specific, achievable goal - this makes it easier to enter flow
flow.current_goal: Current goal: Complete coloring the sketch
flow.choose_duration_goal: Choose how long you want to invest and set a specific, achievable goal
flow.assessment_desc: Please rate your experience in this activity (1 = strongly disagree, 5 = strongly agree)
flow.question_focus: I was completely focused on this activity
flow.question_challenge: The difficulty of this activity was just right for me
flow.question_enjoy: I enjoyed the process of this activity
flow.step1_tip: Having a clear goal is one of the prerequisites for entering flow. When you clearly know what to do and to what extent, the brain automatically enters "task mode" and attention is more easily focused.
flow.step2_tip: Flow research has found that when challenge slightly exceeds skill, people are most likely to enter flow. If this is too easy for you, you can actively increase the difficulty a bit.
flow.step3_tip: Eliminating distractions is not "preparation work" but part of the flow experience. When your space becomes quiet and tidy, the brain receives the signal that "it's focus time now."
flow.step4_tip: Deep breathing activates the parasympathetic nervous system, helping the brain switch from "scattered mode" to "focused mode." Give yourself a small ritual - like three deep breaths - to tell your brain: now, I'm entering my flow time.
flow.via_card_desc: Based on the Peterson & Seligman (2004) VIA framework, a 48-question scientific assessment to find your core strengths and enter flow more easily.
flow.toast_silence_warning: Silent mode is on — please pick another sound first

relax.page_subtitle: Give your body and mind a rest. Simple breathing exercises and meditation guidance to help you find peace.
relax.exercise_breath_desc: 4-7-8 breathing method to help your body relax and relieve tension
relax.exercise_body_scan_desc: Relax your body from head to toe, releasing tension and fatigue
relax.exercise_mindfulness_desc: Focus on the present moment, let your thoughts gradually quiet down
relax.exercise_five_senses_desc: Return to the present moment through your five senses, relieving anxiety
relax.exercise_cat_game_desc: Play a match game with cute cats, relaxing and stress-relieving
relax.breath_subtitle: Breathe with the circle's rhythm to quickly calm physical tension
relax.breath_instruction: Click start and follow the guided breathing exercise
relax.practice_tips_text: Place one hand on your chest and the other on your abdomen. Slowly inhale, feeling your abdomen expand like a balloon. Hold for 2-3 seconds. Slowly exhale, feeling your abdomen contract.
relax.science_breath: Through slow, deep breathing, activate the parasympathetic nervous system, lower cortisol levels, and reduce amygdala hyperactivity.
relax.body_scan_subtitle: Feel every part of your body
relax.body_scan_instruction: Click start, we will scan each part of your body from head to toe
relax.mindfulness_subtitle: Focus on your breath in this moment
relax.mindfulness_instruction: Close your eyes and focus on your breathing. No need to change your breathing, just observe it.
relax.science_neuro_desc: Mindfulness practice can reduce amygdala hyperactivity. 8 weeks of systematic practice can build stable emotion regulation neural pathways. If your mind wanders, gently bring your attention back to your breath.
relax.five_senses_subtitle: Return to the present through your five senses
relax.five_senses_desc: This exercise can help you return to the present from anxious thoughts. Take your time, no rush.
relax.see_5_desc: Look around and find 5 things you can see
relax.hear_3_desc: Listen for 3 sounds you can hear
relax.breath_instruction_default: Tap start and follow the guide for breathing practice
relax.guide_inhale: Breathe in slowly, feel the air entering your body...
relax.guide_hold: Hold it, let your body absorb the oxygen...
relax.guide_exhale: Breathe out slowly, releasing the tension...
relax.scan_instr_head: Place attention on the top of your head. Feel its temperature and sensation. Any tension? Let it soften.
relax.scan_instr_forehead: Feel your forehead. Are you frowning? Let it smooth out and relax.
relax.scan_instr_eyes: Feel around your eyes. Let the eye sockets relax; let the eyes rest naturally.
relax.scan_instr_face: Notice your cheeks and jaw. Are you clenching? Let the mouth open slightly, relax.
relax.scan_instr_shoulders: Feel your shoulders. We often hold tension here. Let them drop, relax.
relax.scan_instr_arms: From upper arms to forearms, all the way to the fingers. Feel their presence, let them fully relax.
relax.scan_instr_chest: Feel your chest. With each breath, feel it rise and fall gently.
relax.scan_instr_abdomen: Place attention on your abdomen. Let the breath come here naturally, feel it rise and fall.
relax.scan_instr_legs: From thighs to calves, all the way to the toes. Feel your legs, let them fully relax.
relax.scan_instr_whole: Now feel the whole body. From head to toe, completely relaxed. Enjoy this calm.
relax.mf_instr_1: Close your eyes and place attention on the breath.
relax.mf_instr_2: Feel the air enter the nose and fill the chest.
relax.mf_instr_3: No need to change the breath — just observe it.
relax.mf_instr_4: If the mind wanders, that’s okay; gently bring it back to the breath.
relax.mf_instr_5: With each breath, let yourself relax a little more.
relax.mf_instr_6: In this moment, only you and your breath.
relax.mf_instr_7: Let the body fully relax; let the thoughts quiet down.
relax.mf_instr_8: You’re doing great — keep focusing on the breath.

role.step2_subtitle: Don't worry, this isn't your problem. Modern life is inherently full of multiple identity challenges.
role.step3_subtitle: Balance isn't perfection - it's making sure every role gets its moment of care.
role.conflict_empty_text: Every role is a part of you, together they make the complete you
role.parent-partner_desc: Parenting responsibilities quietly fill the space between you — a norm in many families.
role.parent-partner_sug: Children need to see you love each other. Set aside "just the two of you" time weekly, even a 20-minute walk.
role.parent-child_desc: Parenting while caring for parents — the typical pressure of the "sandwich generation".
role.parent-child_sug: You need not be perfect. Share responsibility with siblings and allow yourself to be overwhelmed sometimes. Seeking support is wisdom, not failure.
role.partner-child_desc: A delicate balance is sometimes needed between your partnership and caring for parents.
role.partner-child_sug: Invite your partner into your family ties. Visiting parents together makes the bond more natural.
role.sibling-parent_desc: Siblings may hold different views on parenting.
role.sibling-parent_sug: Seek common ground, respect differences; stay aligned on core issues, allow variation in details.
role.employee-parent_desc: Work and parenting both compete for your attention and energy — the most common experience of modern parents.
role.employee-parent_sug: Quality beats quantity. 15 minutes of full attention beats a whole day of "watching the child while on the phone".
role.employee-partner_desc: Work exhaustion often leaves you with no energy for your intimate relationship after hours.
role.employee-partner_sug: Put "date night" in the calendar. Put down the phone before sleep and talk for 10 minutes.
role.employee-child_desc: When work is busy, it is hard to find time to accompany and care for parents.
role.employee-child_sug: Quality matters more than frequency. Call regularly on video, plan home visits ahead for holidays, and help parents find community support.
role.employee-sibling_desc: Busy with work, the bond between siblings may gradually weaken.
role.employee-sibling_sug: Frequent contact is not required, but show up at each other’s important moments. Share small life moments so they know "I am here".
role.freelancer-parent_desc: Working from home lets you be with your child yet blurs work-family boundaries.
role.freelancer-parent_sug: Build a ritual of "work time" with your child. Also teach them: freelancing is real work too.
role.entrepreneur-parent_desc: A startup's uncertainty and intensity can shake your sense of stability as a parent.
role.entrepreneur-parent_sug: Let children understand your work, but do not pass on startup stress. Set "no-work" family time.
role.student-parent_desc: The dual role of student and parent makes your time especially tight.
role.student-parent_sug: You are showing your child the best model of "lifelong learning". Seek school or community parenting support.
role.student-employee_desc: Working while studying leaves little room to breathe.
role.student-employee_sug: Your effort will bear fruit. Plan time wisely and leave moments to rest.
role.parent-learner_desc: Parenting takes much time, and self-improvement plans are often shelved.
role.parent-learner_sug: Let children see Mom and Dad learning too. Use碎片 time to learn; progress needs no big blocks.
role.parent-creator_desc: Creation needs focus and time, while parenting demands being on call.
role.parent-creator_sug: Schedule creation during the child’s stable activities. You can also involve the child in your creation.
role.parent-volunteer_desc: You want to help others, but first must care for yourself and family.
role.parent-volunteer_sug: Volunteer with your child; it helps others and nurtures their empathy.
role.parent-explorer_desc: After having a child, the way you explore the world changes.
role.parent-explorer_sug: Explore with your child — new parks, new foods. Children are the best exploration partners.
role.partner-learner_desc: In growing yourself, your partner may sometimes feel left behind.
role.partner-learner_sug: Share what you learn with your partner. Invite them to learn a topic together.
role.partner-creator_desc: Creation needs solitude and may make your partner feel neglected.
role.partner-creator_sug: Share your creation with your partner. Let them be its first reader.
role.child-learner_desc: Caring for parents and pursuing growth both take effort; time and energy need careful allocation.
role.child-learner_sug: Improving yourself also helps you care for parents. Let them see your progress; they will be proud.
role.child-creator_desc: Creation takes time, and so does caring for parents.
role.child-creator_sug: Combine creation with caring for parents — draw them a picture, write them a poem. They will treasure it.
role.sibling-learner_desc: Each walks a different path of growth.
role.sibling-learner_sug: Occasionally share what you learn with siblings. Blood + growing together is the deepest bond.
role.employee-learner_desc: Tired from work yet still making effort to learn takes strong inner drive.
role.employee-learner_sug: Link learning with work. The 30 minutes before sleep or after waking is the easiest to keep.
role.employee-creator_desc: Work consumes most creativity, making it hard to create after hours.
role.employee-creator_sug: Creation need not be a "big project"; 15 minutes of daily jotting keeps creativity flowing.
role.employee-explorer_desc: Work’s certainty often makes people forget to explore more possibilities.
role.employee-explorer_sug: Exploration need not be "quitting to see the world"; it can be a new restaurant weekly or a book from another field.
role.employee-volunteer_desc: Work is already busy; volunteering may make time feel even tighter.
role.employee-volunteer_sug: Helping others needs no large blocks of time. Extra kindness and patience in daily life are "volunteering".
role.freelancer-creator_desc: Freelancing and creation may compete for your time and energy.
role.freelancer-creator_sug: If possible, let creation be part of your freelance work. Keep sacred, inviolable time for "pure creation".
role.entrepreneur-learner_desc: A startup demands fast learning, yet systematic study is crowded out by urgent tasks.
role.entrepreneur-learner_sug: Embed learning in the startup process. Treat every problem as a study topic.
role.entrepreneur-creator_desc: A startup needs reason and logic; creation needs feeling and inspiration — balance is needed.
role.entrepreneur-creator_sug: A startup is another kind of creation. Treat your venture as your greatest work.
role.entrepreneur-explorer_desc: A startup needs focus and persistence; exploration needs openness and trial.
role.entrepreneur-explorer_sug: A startup itself is exploration. Weave that spirit into it — try new business models.
role.student-creator_desc: Academic pressure may limit the time and energy you give to creation.
role.student-creator_sug: Student years are best for creation. Even 15 minutes daily nourishes creativity.
role.student-explorer_desc: Student years are best for exploration, yet academic pressure may limit it.
role.student-explorer_sug: Weave exploration into learning — take a class you know nothing about, meet a classmate from another background.
role.student-volunteer_desc: Both study and volunteering take your time.
role.student-volunteer_sug: Volunteering is your best "extracurricular education". It may teach more than textbooks.
role.learner-volunteer_desc: Study and volunteering both take leisure time; balance is needed.
role.learner-volunteer_sug: Volunteering itself is learning. Record those experiences; they become precious wealth in life.
role.learner-explorer_desc: Learning and exploration are a natural pair that sparks each other.
role.learner-explorer_sug: Keep this curiosity and desire to learn. Learning and exploring need no "purpose"; the best discoveries come unexpectedly.
role.creator-volunteer_desc: Creation needs focused solitude; volunteering needs outward connection — energy allocation takes wisdom.
role.creator-volunteer_sug: Your creativity can serve others. Teaching your creative skills is meaningful volunteering.
role.creator-explorer_desc: Exploration gives inspiration; creation helps expression — a great duo.
role.creator-explorer_sug: Let exploration be the source of your creation. New places and different people nourish it.
role.explorer-volunteer_desc: Exploring the world and serving others are both ways of opening yourself outward.
role.explorer-volunteer_sug: Volunteering can be exploration — new places, different people. Let them nourish each other.

role.sug_item_boundaries_0: Learn to say “no” gently — protect your own energy
role.sug_item_boundaries_1: Clarify the responsibilities of each role to avoid overstepping
role.sug_item_boundaries_2: Keep a little “me time” every day — you matter too
role.sug_item_timemgmt_0: Use the Pomodoro technique to boost efficiency
role.sug_item_timemgmt_1: Set aside 1 hour each day for what you love
role.sug_item_timemgmt_2: Give each role its own dedicated time
role.sug_item_selfcare_0: Rest is not laziness — it is a necessity to keep going
role.sug_item_selfcare_1: Do one small thing you enjoy every day
role.sug_item_selfcare_2: Talk to a friend, or write down your feelings
role.sug_item_support_0: You don’t have to carry it all alone — reach out to those you trust
role.sug_item_support_1: Professional counseling is a sign of strength, not weakness
role.sug_item_support_2: Join a support group and share with people who understand
